types.feat: a new user-facing feature or capability
types.post: publishing or updating a blog article (this site's custom type)
types.docs: documentation only (e.g. the files in docs/, the README)
types.refactor: code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
types.chore: maintenance that doesn't fit the above (e.g. routine upkeep)

scopes.blog: the blog experience — article listing and article pages under src/
scopes.rss: the feed — src/pages/rss.xml.ts and its tests
scopes.layout: site-wide layout and chrome — src/components/layout/, headers, footers, navigation
scopes.styles: global styling and design tokens — src/styles/
scopes.content: the content collections and their frontmatter schema — src/content/
scopes.deps: dependency updates — package.json and the lockfile
